This block runs into the event, now about 4 weeks away: the final week is competition week, not another training week. This is your final 4-week run-in to Saturday Hyrox: Weeks 1-2 realize race qualities, Week 3 tapers, Week 4 is arrival week. The block peaks Hyrox only; the two weeks after it should pivot back to easy run frequency plus one longer easy run so the half marathon is supported without trying to peak twice now.

Week 2 extends the race-order run/station work and the easy run only a little. Week 3 cuts volume but keeps race pace, race loads, and your squat feel. Week 4 is just sharpness and confidence.

If the left Achilles grumbles after the Monday run-station session, change Friday’s run first: cut 10-15 minutes or replace it with the ski erg or rower for the same duration. Do not stack a makeup run the next day; if symptoms rise above 2/10 or last into the next morning, remove burpee broad jumps before cutting squat or calf capacity work.

Mon	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 s	7	Horizontal pull support. If session runs long, cut 1 set here before touching primary work.	
Mon	Seated Calf Raise	RPE-selected load	3	12	60 s	7	Achilles tissue capacity; 2 s pause in the stretch and at the top.	
Mon	Prowler Push	90-95% competition load	1	25 m	3:00 after pair	7	Hyrox sled-push feel. Smooth drive, no grind.	
Mon	Prowler Push	90-95% competition load	1	25 m	3:00 after pair	7	Perform Hyrox sled pull here. Stay tall and keep steps short.	
Mon	Shuttle Run	Bodyweight	1	20 m	2:30	7	Perform Hyrox burpee broad jump here. Quarter-dose exposure only; crisp rhythm, no redline breathing.	
Mon	Run	4:10-4:15/km	4	800 m	3:00 after each pair	7	Competition-order rehearsal. Rep 1 into ski erg, rep 2 into Prowler Push, rep 3 into sled pull, rep 4 into burpee broad jump. Stop after 3 pairs if pace slips slower than 4:18/km or Achilles rises above 2/10.	
Mon	Rower	1:50-1:51/500 m	1	500 m	3:00 after pair	7	Use SkiErg here; near goal split without forcing. If split drifts by more than 2 s/500 m, stop at 400 m.

Tue	Medicine Ball Scoop Throw	competition ball	2	25 reps	2:00	7	Perform Hyrox wall ball shots here. Quarter-dose exposure. Settle breathing between sets and keep catches clean.

Tue	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	2	12/side	45 s	6	Low-fatigue trunk work for run-to-station bracing.

Wed	Back Squat	117.5 kg	2	2	3:00	6.5-7	About 78% of your 150 kg max. Squat maintenance is held on purpose through the Hyrox peak. If this reaches RPE 8 or bar speed drops, do 1 set only.

Fri	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 s	7	Pull maintenance without extra grip fatigue.

Fri	Run	5:00-5:20/km	1	40 min	N/A	3-4	Secondary half-marathon support run. Easy aerobic only; if Achilles reacts from Wednesday, switch this to ski erg or Rowing Ergometer for the same duration.

TAPER AUDIT
Event: hybrid race, priority A, about 4 weeks out.
This block runs into the event: the final week is competition week.
Sport sessions counted as load: 2 per week.
WEEK PHASES: 1=realization 2=realization 3=taper 4=competition_week EVENT=hybrid_race

    phase             sets  exercises  competition lift  power sets  peak RPE  peak % max
W1  realization       45    15         -                 2           7.5       -
W2  realization       45    15         -                 2           7.5       -
W3  taper             29    11         -                 7           7         -
W4  competition week  15    10         -                 4           7         -

Across the block: volume -30 sets, exercises -5, competition-lift share unchanged, peak effort -0.5 RPE, accessory volume -18 sets.
